places.name: Nueces River
places.note: The herd crosses a little downriver through mosquito swarms; Sean rides into a nest of water moccasins and dies, buried under a live oak near the north bank.
places.location_hint: crossing slightly downriver of the usual one, beyond a mile-wide grassy clearing in the brush; grave about a hundred yards back from the north bank

places.name: Ireland
places.note: Sean longs to sail home there; Newt regrets never urging him to go back.

places.name: Galveston
places.note: Newt wishes he had told Sean to go there and find a ship home.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Destination of the drive; Augustus closes the burial by telling everyone to go on there.

places.name: Matagorda
places.note: The lead steer Old Dog, bought from the Pumphreys, had led several herds there.
places.location_hint: Texas Gulf Coast around Matagorda Bay

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Augustus teases Dish about its women and muses he might stop there to settle near Clara.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Augustus remarks it is a long way off.

places.name: Kentucky
places.note: Home of the horse trader Clara chose to marry.

places.name: Austin
places.note: Augustus recalls Clara telling him of her marriage outside her little store there some sixteen years ago.

places.name: Red River
places.note: Dish wishes they had already reached it, disliking the low country.

places.name: Yellowstone River
places.note: Augustus jokes he wishes they were already there.

places.name: Brazos River
places.note: Call remembers a drying lake far up the river teeming with cottonmouths during a drought summer.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Newt wishes time could run back to when they were still there and Sean was alive.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: just across the Nueces, moving on north from Sean's grave
